name: Susan Colton
bio: Susan Colton taught in public school classrooms and served as a highly respected, nationally recognized principal for over thirty years. She is a sought-after speaker, trainer, and facilitator specializing in building positive relationships with diverse communities. She also served as Director of Leadership Development for Broward County Public Schools, the nation's sixth-largest school district. In 1999, Susan received the Florida Commissioner's Award for Outstanding Leadership. In 2000, she was named a National Distinguished Principal. In 2013, the Broward Education Foundation selected Susan as one of seven inaugural Hall of Fame Distinguished Alumni. Susan published her first book in 2018, Principal's Passion: A Quest for Quality Public Education.An Adjunct Professor at Broward College from 2018-2022, she currently serves on the Board of Directors of the Broward Education Foundation and Chairs the Innovative Teacher Committee. Susan is Broward County Retired Educators Association’s past president and Legislative Chair. In 2023, she was elected District 10 Director for Miami-Dade, Broward, and Palm Beach Counties and is a member of the Legislative Team for the Florida Retired Educators Association. She proudly serves on the Education Foundation Board for the Greater Pompano Beach Chamber of Commerce and the Board of Directors for Shipwreck Park/Wahoo Bay.
